description: Source code implementing memory page management functions for POSIX systems, including mapping, unmapping, protection, and file-backed memory mapping, with version-specific behavior.

methods.name: SbMemoryMapFlagsToMmapProtect
methods.description: Converts internal memory protection flags to POSIX mmap protection flags.

methods.name: GetPageCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of pages for a given byte size.

methods.name: SbPageMapUntracked
methods.description: Maps memory without tracking, considering executable memory restrictions.

methods.name: SbPageMap
methods.description: Maps memory pages with tracking, updates page count.

methods.name: SbPageUnmap
methods.description: Unmaps memory pages and updates page count.

methods.name: SbPageProtect
methods.description: Changes protection on mapped memory pages.
